'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Scott DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
